title: Open Chord Music
venue_description:
Open Chord Music - Knoxville's Premier Live Music Venue & Shop

A unique combination of live music venue, restaurant/bar, café, and full guitar/music shop in West Knoxville. Known for quality sound and supportive music community.

Live Music and Events

Regular open mic nights alongside touring and local acts. Great listening room atmosphere.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Full bar, café food, retail music shop, and welcoming space for musicians and fans.
